## Scientific review checklist

- [ ] Full CI is green.
- [ ] No raw/provider market data are committed.
- [ ] Any protocol change is documented in `paper/protocol_deviations.md`.
- [ ] Forecast-origin, target-horizon, and exchange-session invariants are preserved.
- [ ] No empirical VRP, forecast-ranking, GARCH, or regime conclusion was introduced without an audited production data freeze.
- [ ] New numerical outputs state their units and are reproducible from versioned code/configuration.
- [ ] Coauthor review is complete before merge.
